question: How do scope resolvers trade total latency at the same search quality under a shared fixed backend?
claim: Quality equality and observed latency differences are descriptive for this independent 10k time sample; no original Viking or universal speedup claim.
archetype: quantitative grid, two separate single-axis figures
export: 127 x 105 mm; SVG/PDF editable text and 600dpi PNG/TIFF; glyphs >= 5pt; no submission journal specified
n: 5 independent processes, same deterministic ANN seed/data; 20 timed sweeps after 3 warmups; repeated calls are technical repeats
uncertainty: horizontal SD (ddof=1) of five per-process nonempty mean latencies, not a confidence interval
exclusions: 266 empty nonrecursive year scopes omitted only from Recall and primary curves; all-request and empty latencies retained in results table
integrity: No observations trimmed. No image manipulation, interpolation, smoothing, or log transform.
alignment: single axis per exported figure; run helper to record not applicable
